latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the clarity-literature skill.
- Search for research papers and retrieve publication details from Clarity Protocol.
- Supports querying by keywords and fetching paper details using PubMed ID (PMID).
- Provides citation metrics, full-text availability, and paper metadata.
- Allows up to 10 requests/min without an API key; 100 requests/min with an API key.
- Includes error handling for not found, rate limits, server errors, and timeouts.
